description: Proposes a rewrite of operational tactics after a run. Cannot install the rewrite; a deterministic auditor is the only writer.

invocation.rationale: Runs after a terminal work node so the next scheduled invocation starts with updated tactics. Gated by ARMCL_EVOLVE.

tier1.rationale: Reads the run outcome and proxy score. Writing would let the rewriter edit the evidence it is scored on.

tier2.rationale: Reads the ledger to see which attempts were refused. Must not label them itself.

tier3.rationale: May recover the current playbook. Installing a generation is the auditor's job, not this agent's.

guardrails.rationale: Consumes fleet-internal state produced after ingress screening. The auditor, not a content filter, is the control on what it may change.
